sources.title: Introduction :: Nestjs AI Reference
sources.snippet: Introduction NestJS AI is a TypeScript/NestJS port of the Spring AI project. It mirrors Spring AI's module structure and API design while adapting them to Node.js idioms (Zod schemas, NestJS dynamic modules, RxJS, props objects).

sources.title: LLM.js — Universal LLM Interface
sources.snippet: LLM.js combines the fetched models from each provider, with the feature and cost list from LiteLLM. This provides real-time cost per input/output token, and model features like context window, tool support, thinking support, and more!
